title: Page 3
content_zh:
费忠贵的二弟，也就是费明兰的嫡亲二叔费忠良，以婢女生的庶子不算嗣子，没有继承权为由，要把自己的嫡出小儿子过继给费明兰的母亲，想夺取家产的野心再明显也不过。

更过分的是，费氏族长原本是费明兰的父亲费忠贵，费忠贵一死，族长之权也被费忠良抢去，他又以族长的名义，说费氏兰苑占的土地原本是费氏的祭田，属于祀产，如今费忠贵己死，族里要收回兰苑所占土地。

兰苑的土地，明明是费忠贵当初购买的别家良田，哪里是什么费氏祭田？

【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】

费家的偌大家产，也许过不到一两年，就会被费忠良以各种莫须有的名义给蚕食鲸吞殆尽。

费明兰的庶出兄长费明德是个书呆子，管不了事：母亲费郑氏是娇弱女子，不问俗事，再加上毕竟是内宅女子，说话也没有分量：庶出的妹妹费明蕙就更别提了。

而费明兰的二叔费忠良考上了举人，成了举人老爷，算是半个官身，在官场上也说得上话，再加上费忠贵人死茶凉，费明兰真是举目无依，满心苍凉。

她生平只恨自己为什么不是男子，要不然又怎么会被二叔欺负至此，毫无反抗之力。

一叔一句「女儿早晚要出嫁，是别家的人，管不得费家的家事。」就把她堵得说不出话。

而这些苦楚，费明兰又无法向她这些所谓的闺中好友倾诉，说了也只会惹别人笑话。

人们乐意锦上添花，却少有愿意雪中送炭的。更何况费家的家产之争，外人确实也难以插手。

至于费明蕙的婚事，其中的确有些无法让外人知道的隐情，更是一言难尽。

因此面对姜淑梅的质问，费明兰思考了一下，才淡笑着道：「这是两家长辈议定了的婚事，必是良缘。」

姜淑荷不屑地扁了扁嘴，道：「你然也太好性子了，我是最看不过你家二小姐那一副随时随地楚楚可怜、恨不得风吹就倒的样子，好好走路好好说话都不会，扭捏给谁看呢？」

姜淑梅眨了眨眼，配合姊姊略带嘲讽地笑道：「自然是给那些怜香惜玉的公子看的，不然刺史家二公子怎么会选中她呢？连替父亲服丧守孝也不顾了，赶着要嫁人呢！」

童茹芸和费明兰的私交更好些，她虽然不太清楚这柱婚事有什么蹊跷内幕，但总觉得是自家姊妹受了委屈，便用手帕掩着嘴角，轻笑道：「说起这个呀，我倒想起了豫章黄先生在『书幽芳亭记』里写的几句话：『然兰熏之才德不同，世罕能别之』」

姜淑梅立即快嘴接道：「『一干一花而香有余者兰，一干五七花而香不足者蕙。』蕙远不如兰也。」

花厅里的少女都是各家的嫡女，自然不喜那些妾生的庶女姊妹，所以自然而然地与费明兰同仇敌忾，敌视费明蕙。

她们巧用古人区别「兰」与「熏」的差异，讽刺「明蕙」不如「明兰」。

在懂行人眼里，兰花与熏花看起来相差不多，叶形相似，花朵彷佛，香气也有些雷同，但是在真正讲究的鉴赏家眼中，熏花多而俗，兰花少而雅，所谓「盖兰似君子，熏似士大夫，大概山林中十熏而一兰也悔」。

费明兰尴尬地笑笑，不好搭话。

她其实并没有如外人想象的那般讨厌费明蕙。

费明蕙自幼体弱，所以一举一动难免弱不禁风，她的性子比起坚强硬气的费明兰要娇软许多，向来唯父命、兄命是从，喜爱风花雪月，不爱谈论钱币俗物，倒比费明兰更像费郑氏的嫡亲女儿。

费郑氏确实是想把费明兰嫁入刺史府，即使她再不通俗务，毕竟跟着丈夫费忠贵这么多年，多少也知道商人受官吏欺压搜刮的苦闷。官夫人比起富太太，那地位不知高了多少，哪里还会怕被二叔抢夺财产？

本来在孝期议亲不合礼仪，但是费忠贵死得仓卒，许多后事没有安排妥当，费郑氏实在担心费家的未来，加上也急着想借着替女儿说亲，帮自家找个新的靠山，于是匆匆便先议定好了亲事，等费明兰服完了二十七个月的孝期再出嫁，这安排也是挺妥当的。

今年费明兰精心培育的「素心如雪」第一次开了花，惊艳全城，费郑氏趁机提前邀请了一些青年才俊来赏花，顺便想拉拢一下刺史府的二公子。

哪里知道，刺史府的二公子周孝光来是来了，却不知道怎么闯入了后宅，正巧费明蕙在内宅小湖边休憩，发现陌生男子闯入，惊吓之下失足落水，周孝光勇救落水美人，两人肌肤相贴，手足相缠，头发交织，费明蕙的闺誉等于毁于一旦了。

费明蕙是个楚楚可怜的小美人，再加上落水之后更加显得苍白娇弱，秋水明眸中泪光点点，欲哭强忍的模样让周孝光怜香惜玉之心大动，冲动之下竟然又抱紧了她。

这下费明蕙如果再不能嫁他，大概只有死路一条了。

费明蕙的同母兄长费明德也知道自己庶出的妹妹实在不够资格做周孝光的嫡妻，便婉转相告即使做妾也可，反正周孝光是一定要对妹妹负责的。

万幸周孝光是个情深意重的「好男人」，当即允诺发誓不介意费明蕙的出身，愿意求娶她为正妻。

反正周二公子不是家中的嫡长子，没有太重的家庭压力，周家父母见他态度坚决，甚至绝食抗议，也只好答应了这门亲事。

刺史周大人原本是想让二儿子娶费明兰的，他也眼馋费忠贵死后留下的巨额财产，但又顾着官声，不好做破门抢财的「贪官」，便想着怎么也要错着联姻抢一部分过来。

如今儿子不争气，偏偏看中了费家的庶女，周大人皱着眉头应下了，实属于「没鱼，虾也可」的无奈让步。

反正不管费家嫁哪个女儿，周大人都是要让费家出一大笔嫁妆的，否则，也配不上他堂堂官家公子不是？

费明兰的奶娘王嬷嬷对这件事大为恼恨，私下咬牙切齿地对费明兰嘀咕：「怎么就那么凑巧遇到，又凑巧落水？一年到头在湖边玩也没见她失足过，偏偏周公子来了，她就落水了！身边服侍的佣人都死了吗？还不知道那小浪蹄子耍了什么花招呢！少爷也跟着凑热闹。唯恐自己一母同胞的妹妹嫁不出去似的，抢着把周公子许给那小蹄子，却把小姐您置之不顾。枉费太太自幼疼他，小姐向来尊敬他，他还不是和自己妹妹近？我就说，不是一个娘生的就是亲不了，怎么养也养不熟，根本就是两个忘恩负义的家伙。」

费明兰又能说什么呢？唯有苦笑而己。

她从来不愿意把自家的兄妹往坏处想，毕竟他们也才兄妹三人，如果再不团结，那费家就真的要完蛋了。

可是这次的刺史公子订婚事件，着实打击了费明兰，再加上二叔闹的那种种事情，让她最近一直心情郁郁寡欢。

不过她向来不是个肯认输的姑娘，更没有非周公子不嫁的念头，既然与周孝光无缘，她就索性大方地祝福明蕙了。

她相信自己自有姻缘在，就算嫁不进官家，只要找个品德好的丈夫，也未尝不是幸事？

她相信父亲自幼对她的教导：「要学会自己掌握幸福，不要依赖他人。」

费忠贵是个开明的商人，从来不以那些三从四德的古板教条来教育自己偏宠的嫡女，他教育她识字读书，教育她理财打算盘，教育她学会思考独寸自主，更教育她如何应对世事。
content_en:
Fei Zhonggui's second brother, Fei Minglan's biological second uncle, Fei Zhongliang, wanted to adopt his youngest son to Fei Minglan's mother on the grounds that the bastard son of a maid girl was not an heir and had no inheritance rights. His ambition to seize the family property could not be more obvious.

What's even more outrageous is that the patriarch of the Fei clan was originally Fei Zhonggui, Fei Minglan's father. When Fei Zhonggui died, Fei Zhongliang also took away the power of the clan leader. In the name of the clan leader, he said that the land occupied by Fei's Orchid Garden was originally Fei's sacrificial land and was a sacrificial property. Now that Fei Zhonggui is dead, the clan wants to take back the land occupied by Lanyuan.

The land in Lanyuan is obviously fertile land purchased by Fei Zhonggui from another family. Where is Fei's sacrificial land?

[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]

The Fei family's huge property may be eaten up by Fei Zhongliang in various unreasonable names in less than a year or two.

Fei Minglan's concubine brother Fei Mingde is a nerd and can't take care of things; his mother Fei Zheng is a delicate woman who doesn't care about worldly affairs. In addition, she is a housewife after all, and her words have no weight; let alone her concubine sister Fei Minghui.

And Fei Minglan's second uncle, Fei Zhongliang, was admitted to the Juren Examination and became a Juren Master. He was considered to be half an official and could speak well in the officialdom. In addition, Fei Zhong's noble death was so cold that Fei Minglan was really helpless and full of desolation.

All her life she only hated herself for not being a man, otherwise how could she have been bullied by her second uncle to this point without any power to resist.

Uncle Yi said, "Sooner or later, my daughter will get married. She belongs to another family and has no control over the Fei family's family affairs." She was silenced.

And Fei Minglan couldn't talk about these pains to her so-called close friends, and if she did, she would only make others laugh.

People are willing to add icing on the cake, but few are willing to provide help in times of need.What's more, it is indeed difficult for outsiders to intervene in the Fei family's property dispute.

As for Fei Minghui's marriage, there are indeed some secrets in it that cannot be known to outsiders, and it is even more difficult to describe.

Therefore, facing Jiang Shumei's question, Fei Minglan thought for a moment and then said with a smile: "This is a marriage agreed upon by the elders of the two families. It must be a good match."

Jiang Shuhe flattened her mouth in disdain and said, "You are too good-tempered. What I hate the most is how pitiful your second lady is at any time and place, wishing she would collapse in the wind. She can't walk or talk properly. Who can show her to you?"

Jiang Shumei blinked and matched her sister with a slightly mocking smile: "Of course it is for those young gentlemen who love her and cherish her. Otherwise, how could the second young master of the governor's family choose her? She doesn't even care about mourning for her father and is in a hurry to get married!"

Tong Ruyun and Fei Minglan had a better personal relationship. Although she didn't know what was behind this marriage, she always felt that her sister had been wronged. She covered her mouth with a handkerchief and chuckled: "Speaking of this, I remembered a few words written by Mr. Huang of Yuzhang in "Shu You Fang Pavilion": "However, Lan Xun has different talents and virtues, and few people in the world can tell them apart."

Jiang Shumei immediately said quickly: "'One stem with one flower but more than enough fragrance is orchid; one stem with five or seven flowers but not enough fragrance is hui.' The hui is far inferior to the orchid."

The girls in the flower hall were all legitimate daughters of each family, so naturally they did not like the concubine sisters, so they naturally shared the same hatred with Fei Minglan and were hostile to Fei Minghui.

They cleverly used the ancient distinction between "lan" and "xun" to mock "Minghui" as inferior to "Minglan".

In the eyes of knowledgeable people, orchids and orchids look similar, with similar leaf shapes, similar flowers, and similar aromas. However, in the eyes of truly discerning connoisseurs, orchids are more common and vulgar, while orchids are rare and elegant. As the saying goes, "covering orchids is like a gentleman, and having orchids is like a scholar-official. Maybe ten orchids in the mountains and forests will regret it."

Fei Minglan smiled awkwardly, not being easy to talk to.

In fact, she didn't hate Fei Minghui as much as outsiders imagined.

Fei Minghui has been weak since she was a child, so her every move is inevitably frail. Her temperament is much softer than the strong-willed Fei Minglan. She has always followed her father's orders and her brother's orders. She loves romance and does not like to talk about money and worldly things. She is more like Fei Zheng's direct daughter than Fei Minglan.

Fei Zheng really wanted to marry Fei Minglan into the governor's office. Even if she was not involved in ordinary affairs, after following her husband Fei Zhonggui for so many years, she knew to some extent the distress of businessmen being oppressed and plundered by officials.The status of an official wife is much higher than that of a rich wife. How can she be afraid of being robbed of her property by her second uncle?

Originally, it was not etiquette to propose a marriage during the period of mourning, but Fei Zhonggui died in a hurry and many funeral arrangements were not properly arranged. Fei Zheng was really worried about the future of the Fei family, and she was also anxious to find a new supporter for her family by arranging marriage for her daughter, so she hastily agreed on the marriage first, and waited until Fei Minglan had completed the twenty-seven months of mourning period before getting married. This arrangement was quite appropriate.

This year, Fei Minglan's carefully cultivated "Su Xin Ru Xue" bloomed for the first time, stunning the whole city. Fei Zheng took the opportunity to invite some young talents to come to enjoy the flowers in advance, and also wanted to win over the second son of the governor's office.

Who knew that Zhou Xiaoguang, the second son of the Governor's Mansion, was here, but somehow he broke into the back house. Fei Minghui happened to be resting by the small lake in the house, and found a strange man breaking in. He was frightened and fell into the water. Zhou Xiaoguang rescued the beauty who fell into the water. Their skin touched each other, their hands and feet were entangled, and their hair was intertwined. Fei Minghui's reputation as a best friend was destroyed.

Fei Minghui was a pitiful little beauty, and she looked even more pale and fragile after falling into the water. There were tears in Qiu Shui's bright eyes, and she was trying to hold back her tears. Zhou Xiaoguang was so moved by his pity that he hugged her tightly again impulsively.

If Fei Minghui can no longer marry him, she will probably die.

Fei Minghui's half-brother Fei Mingde also knew that his concubine sister was not qualified to be Zhou Xiaoguang's legitimate wife, so he tactfully told her that she could be a concubine. Anyway, Zhou Xiaoguang must be responsible for his sister.

Fortunately, Zhou Xiaoguang was a affectionate and "good man". He immediately promised that he would not mind Fei Minghui's background and was willing to marry her as his wife.

Anyway, Young Master Zhou was not the eldest son of the family, and there was no heavy family pressure. Seeing that his attitude was resolute, Zhou's parents even went on a hunger strike, so they had no choice but to agree to the marriage.

Lord Zhou, the governor, originally wanted his second son to marry Fei Minglan. He also coveted the huge property left by Fei Zhonggui after his death, but he was concerned about his official reputation and could not be a "corrupt official" who broke into houses and grabbed money, so he thought that he would seize part of it through a wrong marriage.

Now that his son has failed to live up to expectations, he has chosen the concubine of the Fei family. Mr. Zhou frowned and agreed. It was a helpless concession of "no fish, just shrimp".

Anyway, no matter which daughter the Fei family marries, Mr. Zhou will ask the Fei family to pay a large dowry. Otherwise, she will not be worthy of his dignified official son, right?

Fei Minglan's nanny, Grandma Wang, was very angry about this incident. She gnashed her teeth and muttered to Fei Minglan in private: "How come we met her by chance and fell into the water by chance? We played by the lake all year round and I didn't see her slipping. But when Mr. Zhou came, she fell into the water! Are all the servants around her dead? I don't know what tricks that little prodigal hoof played! The young master also followed.Just to join in the fun.I'm afraid that my sister from the same mother will not get married, so I rush to marry Mr. Zhou, but I ignore you.It's in vain that Mrs. Fei has loved him since she was a child, and she has always respected him.Isn't he close to his sister?

What can Fei Minglan say?I can only smile bitterly.

She was never willing to think bad things about her siblings. After all, they were only three siblings. If they didn't unite, the Fei family would really be doomed.

But this time the governor's engagement incident really hit Fei Minglan, and coupled with the troubles caused by her second uncle, she had been feeling depressed recently.

However, she had never been a girl willing to admit defeat, and she had no intention of marrying anyone other than Mr. Zhou. Since she was not destined to Zhou Xiaoguang, she simply blessed Minghui generously.

She believed that she was destined for marriage. Even if she couldn't marry into an official family, as long as she found a husband with good moral character, wouldn't it be a blessing?

She believes in what her father taught her since childhood: "Learn to control your own happiness and not rely on others."

Fei Zhonggui was an enlightened businessman. He never educated his favored legitimate daughter with the old-fashioned dogma of three obediences and four virtues. He taught her to read and read, financial planning, how to think independently, and how to deal with the world.
